object: Hugh G. Bell claimant-specific section of the consolidated Commission decision

layers.label: maker
layers.title: The Commission makes the assessment.
layers.text: This is an administrative assessment of the evidentiary reach of Hugh G. Bell’s oral statement. It is not Hugh’s conclusion and not a historical verdict.
layers.prompt: Open the institutional voice that made the compact answer.

layers.label: selected input
layers.title: The selected input is Hugh G. Bell’s oral statement.
layers.text: The decision says the oral statement attempted to show Hugh’s birth in Mississippi, lifelong residence there, one-quarter Choctaw blood, descent through his father, and reported registration of that father in the old Choctaw Nation in 1836.
layers.quote: This is the Commission’s characterization of the attempted showing—not a quotation of Hugh’s complete examination.
layers.prompt: Open the testimony the Commission expressly assesses.

layers.label: applied frame
layers.title: The Commission names three things the testimony did not tend to show.
items: By whom Hugh’s father was registered.
Whether his father was recognized by Choctaw tribal authorities in Mississippi as a member of the Choctaw tribe there.
Whether his father or any other alleged Choctaw ancestor complied or attempted to comply with Article Fourteen of the 1830 treaty.
layers.quote: The source says there is nothing in his testimony which would tend to show these things.
layers.prompt: Open the administrative criteria contained inside the answer.
